title: Crimson Vigil
description: A surreal red-tinted scene shows a figure in a red robe with wild black hair standing in a cluttered vintage room, head bowed. Above, a large bearded male face with long dark hair floats behind a horizontal wooden beam, staring directly forward with a serious expression.
prompt: A haunting surreal scene in a vintage room with floral wallpaper and old framed pictures, a figure in a flowing red robe stands with head bowed and spiky black hair obscuring their face, above them a giant disembodied head of a long-haired bearded man floats behind a dark wooden beam staring intensely at the viewer, dramatic crimson lighting and haze throughout the room, painterly brushwork, moody and unsettling atmosphere
